gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Recurrent Glioblastoma; Supratentorial Glioblastoma; Brain Tumor
Recurrent supratentorial glioblastoma (GBM) confirmed via prior histology by the site's neuropathologist or designate.

candidate_evidence.quote: Lerapolturev delivered once intratumorally via convection enhanced delivery. Pembrolizumab given intravenously every 3 weeks.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: First or second relapse supported by MRI or CT scan; relapse is defined as progression following initial/prior therapy(ies).

role_evidence.quote: Lerapolturev (5x10\^7 TCID50) delivered intratumorally via convection enhanced delivery (CED).

agents.drug_class_hint: oncolytic poliovirus-rhinovirus chimera (PVSRIPO), intratumoral convection-enhanced delivery

role_evidence.quote: Pembrolizumab (200 mg IV) given every 3 weeks.

A Phase 2, Open-label, Single-arm Study Evaluating the Efficacy, Safety and Tolerability of Lerapolturev (PVSRIPO) and the Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Pembrolizumab in the Treatment of Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

Undergone prior vaccination against PV and received a boost immunization with trivalent inactivated poliovirus vaccine (IPOL®) at least 1 week, but less than 6 weeks, prior to administration of Lerapolturev.

agents.drug_class_hint: prophylactic inactivated poliovirus vaccine booster (safety precaution before oncolytic poliovirus)

coder_notes: Pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent (oncolytic virus lerapolturev is an excluded type) -> experimental_monotherapy, as in the manual's pembrolizumab + vaccine example; regimen combination with lerapolturev. Lerapolturev formulation_flag new_route (CED) is descriptive only. IPOL polio booster is required before lerapolturev for every patient (eligibility), not a registered intervention; listed as supportive (non-cancer prophylactic vaccine) for transparency, could be omitted. Conditional Tdap booster and acetaminophen/diphenhydramine premedication not listed. MGMT mentioned only in description of prior therapy, not a biomarker.
